summary: McAfee Hill cabin lookout, built in the 1940s and gone by 1952; a visit found no footings, and access needs a Rayonier permit as of 2017.

facts.status_note: The cabin was gone by 1952. Willhite found no footings, only an old battery pit.

access.note: A Rayonier Timber permit was required as of 2017, per Willhite. A seasonal permit allowed driving to the summit in hunting season; the annual permit allowed access from about mid-January to June 30 without driving in.

visit.trail_note: Many gates; Willhite's route covered 18 miles round-trip, by bike on a general access permit.

events.note: Cabin gone by 1952 per the register, which says it was built in the 1940s; firelookout.com says 'Gone 1952'.

evidence.supports: Cabin built in the 1940s and gone by 1952
evidence.quote: Built in the 1940s, this cabin was gone by 1952.

evidence.supports: Administered by Washington Division of Forestry/DNR

evidence.quote: Located in a vast area of flat ground, Macafee Hill rises up, but not by much

evidence.supports: Cabin on the summit as a fire lookout in the 1940s, gone in 1952
evidence.quote: At some point in the 1940s, there was a cabin on the summit as a fire lookout but it was gone in 1952 (Kresek).

evidence.supports: No footings found; a credible person said they remain
evidence.quote: I was told by a credible person that there were footings remaining but I found nothing.

evidence.supports: Old radio batteries garbage pit found on site
evidence.quote: I did find the old radio batteries garbage pit.
You are required to purchase a permit for this area, from Rayonier Timber as of 2017.

evidence.supports: Seasonal permit allows driving to the summit in hunting season
evidence.quote: IF you purchase this seasonal permit, you can then drive to the summit during hunting season.
have access from around mid-January to June 30 (non-hunting season)
Many gates gain access to the area

sources.title: Macafee Hill Lookout Site - Grays Harbor County

notes_for_editor: All sources say 1940s for the cabin, so no single build year is recorded. The 1952 date is the removal year, not a build date. Spelling varies (McAfee and Macafee); the register uses McAfee. The access level 'permission' follows Willhite's 2017 permit note and may be out of date. Rex's page (washingtonlookouts.weebly.com/macafee-hill.html) was only checked at its tail and lists the site as Removed; it is not cited.
